# Command reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-commands.mjs from src/commands/registry.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every command prints one JSON object: `{"ok": true, "target": "live" | "headless" | "app", "result": …}` or `{"ok": false, "error": {"code", "message"}}`.
The same commands are MCP tools named `pob_<group>_<action>` on the service's `/mcp` endpoint.

`target` tells where the command ran: `live` = the open PoB window, `headless` = PoB AI's background copy of the build, `app` = PoB AI itself.

## App

### `pob open`

Open the PoB window with PoB AI attached (starts the service if needed)

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--build` | string | Build file to open (optional) |

### `pob status`

Show the PoB install, the service and whether the PoB window is connected

### `pob setup [pobPath]`

Remember where PoB is installed, or install PoB (--install-pob)

PoB updates itself after that; PoB AI follows because it attaches to whatever PoB version is installed.

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--install-pob` | boolean | Download the latest portable PoB (PoE2) from its GitHub releases into the PoB AI data folder |

### `pob version`

PoB AI, Node.js and PoB versions

### `pob doctor`

Check the PoB install, the adapter, the window connection, updates and agents

### `pob restart`

Restart the PoB AI service (the PoB window and panel reconnect)

## update

### `pob update check`

Check for a newer PoB AI

### `pob update apply`

Download and install the newer PoB AI (used from the next start)

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--restart` | boolean | Restart PoB AI right away (the PoB window stays open and reconnects) |

## Engine

### `pob engine info`

PoB version and engine mode (live window or headless)

### `pob engine ops`

Operations the PoB AI adapter provides (diagnostics)

## Build

### `pob build summary`

Current build: class, level, main skill, key stats, file and save state

### `pob build new`

Start a new empty build *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--name` | string | Build name |
| `--class` | string | Class name, e.g. Ranger |
| `--ascendancy` | string | Ascendancy name |
| `--level` | integer | Character level |
| `--discard` | boolean | Throw away unsaved changes in the open PoB build |

### `pob build list`

List saved builds in the PoB build folder

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--search` | string | Filter by name |
| `--folder` | string | Sub-folder inside the build folder |

### `pob build open <build>`

Open a saved build by name or file path *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--discard` | boolean | Throw away unsaved changes in the open PoB build |

### `pob build import <source>`

Import a build from a PoB code or link (pobb.in, poe.ninja, pastebin, …) *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--name` | string | Name for the imported build |
| `--discard` | boolean | Throw away unsaved changes in the open PoB build |

```bash
pob build import https://pobb.in/abc123
pob build import eNrtfWl…
```

### `pob build export`

Export the current build as a PoB code or XML

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--format` | `code` \| `xml` | code or xml (default "code") |
| `--out` | string | Write to this file instead of printing |

### `pob build save`

Save the build (like PoB Save / Save As) *(changes the build)*

Without --name it saves to the current file (the first save picks the build name).

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--name` | string | Save as a new file with this name |
| `--overwrite` | boolean | Replace an existing file with the same name |

### `pob build rename <name>`

Rename the current build *(changes the build)*

### `pob build share`

Upload the build and return a share link (pobb.in, poe.ninja, Maxroll, poe2db)

This publishes the build on the chosen site. Only run it when the user asks to share.

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--site` | `pobb.in` \| `poe.ninja` \| `maxroll` \| `poe2db` | Where to upload (default "pobb.in") |

### `pob build delete <build>`

Delete a saved build file (needs --yes)

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--yes` | boolean | Confirm the deletion |

### `pob build rename-file <build> <name>`

Rename a saved build file

### `pob build move <build> <folder>`

Move a saved build into a folder of the build folder

### `pob build folder-new <folder>`

Create a folder in the build folder

### `pob build loadouts`

Loadouts (a tree, item, skill and config set sharing one name)

### `pob build loadout-select <loadout>`

Switch to a loadout *(changes the build)*

### `pob build loadout-new <name>`

Create a loadout (new sets, or a copy of the current loadout) *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--copy` | boolean | Copy the current loadout |

### `pob build loadout-rename <loadout> <name>`

Rename a loadout *(changes the build)*

### `pob build loadout-delete <loadout>`

Delete a loadout and its sets *(changes the build)*

### `pob build undo <area>`

Undo the last change in one area (like Ctrl+Z on that tab) *(changes the build)*

### `pob build redo <area>`

Redo the last undone change in one area *(changes the build)*

### `pob build minions`

Spectres or companions in the build library; with --search, the ones you can add

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--library` | `spectre` \| `beast` | spectre or beast (companions) (default "spectre") |
| `--search` | string | Search the available minions |
| `--limit` | integer | Maximum results (default 25) |

### `pob build minion-add <minion>`

Add a spectre or companion to the build library *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--library` | `spectre` \| `beast` | spectre or beast (companions) (default "spectre") |

### `pob build minion-remove <minion>`

Remove a spectre or companion from the build library *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--library` | `spectre` \| `beast` | spectre or beast (companions) (default "spectre") |

### `pob build load-xml`

Load a build from PoB XML text (advanced) *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--xml` (required) | string | PoB build XML |
| `--name` | string | Build name |
| `--file` | string | File path relative to the build folder |
| `--discard` | boolean | Throw away unsaved changes in the open PoB build |

### `pob build paths`

PoB build and settings folders (advanced)

### `pob build xml`

Current build as PoB XML (advanced)

## Character

### `pob character classes`

List classes and their ascendancies

### `pob character level <level>`

Set the character level *(changes the build)*

### `pob character class <class>`

Change class (resets the passive tree like PoB does) *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--connect` | boolean | Keep the tree by allocating a path to the new class start instead of resetting it |

### `pob character ascendancy <ascendancy>`

Change ascendancy *(changes the build)*

## Passive tree

### `pob tree summary`

Allocated points, keystones, notables, ascendancy and jewel sockets

### `pob tree search <text>`

Find passive nodes by name or stat text

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--type` | `normal` \| `notable` \| `keystone` \| `socket` \| `ascendancy` \| `attribute` | Only this node type |
| `--allocated` | boolean | Only allocated (true) or unallocated (false) nodes |
| `--limit` | integer | Maximum results (default 25) |
| `--match` | string[] | Exact English names or node ids to match instead of text (filled in for searches in other languages) |

### `pob tree node <node>`

Details of one passive node, including the path from your tree

### `pob tree allocate <node>`

Allocate a node and the shortest path to it *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--weapon-set` | `1` \| `2` | Allocate as a weapon set 1 or 2 passive |
| `--attribute` | `str` \| `dex` \| `int` | Attribute for attribute nodes on the path: str, dex or int |

### `pob tree deallocate <node>`

Remove a node (and nodes that depend on it) *(changes the build)*

### `pob tree attribute <node> <attribute>`

Choose the attribute granted by an attribute node *(changes the build)*

### `pob tree reset`

Refund all passive points (keeps class and ascendancy) *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--keep-ascendancy` | boolean | Keep ascendancy nodes (default true) |

### `pob tree sets`

List passive tree sets

### `pob tree set-select <set>`

Switch to a passive tree set *(changes the build)*

### `pob tree set-new`

Create a passive tree set *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--name` | string | Set name |
| `--copy` | boolean | Copy the current set |

### `pob tree set-rename <name>`

Rename the active passive tree set *(changes the build)*

### `pob tree set-delete <set>`

Delete a passive tree set *(changes the build)*

### `pob tree url-export`

Passive tree as a shareable tree link

### `pob tree url-import <url>`

Replace the active passive tree from a tree link *(changes the build)*

### `pob tree note <node> [text]`

Attach a note to a passive node (PoB 0.23+; empty text removes it) *(changes the build)*

### `pob tree versions`

Tree version of the build and the versions PoB supports

### `pob tree convert <version>`

Convert the active tree set to another tree version *(changes the build)*

## Skills

### `pob skills list`

Skill groups, their gems and which skill is the main skill

### `pob skills add <gems>`

Add a skill group from gem names *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--label` | string | Group label |
| `--slot` | string | Item slot the group is socketed in |
| `--level` | integer | Gem level for all gems |
| `--quality` | integer | Quality for all gems |

```bash
pob skills add "Spark" "Controlled Destruction" --level 20
```

### `pob skills remove <group>`

Remove a skill group *(changes the build)*

### `pob skills set <group>`

Change a skill group (enabled, label, slot, Full DPS, count) *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--enabled` | boolean | Enable or disable the group |
| `--label` | string | Label |
| `--slot` | string | Item slot |
| `--full-dps` | boolean | Include in Full DPS |
| `--count` | integer | Number of copies (e.g. totems, minions) |

### `pob skills main <group>`

Choose the main skill used for the sidebar and DPS *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--active` | integer | Which active skill in the group (1 = first) |
| `--part` | integer | Skill part / stage number |
| `--minion` | string | Minion to use for minion skills |

### `pob skills sets`

List skill sets

### `pob skills set-select <set>`

Switch to a skill set *(changes the build)*

### `pob skills set-new`

Create a skill set *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--name` | string | Set name |
| `--copy` | boolean | Copy the current set |

### `pob skills set-delete <set>`

Delete a skill set *(changes the build)*

## Items

### `pob items list`

Equipped items by slot and items in the build

### `pob items show <item>`

Full text and modifiers of an item

### `pob items add`

Add an item from its in-game copy text (Ctrl+C), optionally equipping it *(changes the build)*

Text copied from the game client in any supported language is converted to the English text PoB reads.

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--text` (required) | string | Item text |
| `--equip` | string | Slot to equip it in |

### `pob items add-english`

Add an item from English PoB item text (advanced) *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--text` (required) | string | English item text |
| `--equip` | string | Slot to equip it in |

### `pob items add-unique <name>`

Add a unique item from PoB's unique list *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--equip` | string | Slot to equip it in |
| `--variant` | integer | Variant number when the unique has several |

### `pob items craft`

Create a custom item from a base type and modifier lines *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--base` (required) | string | Base type, e.g. "Lunar Amulet" |
| `--rarity` | `NORMAL` \| `MAGIC` \| `RARE` \| `UNIQUE` | NORMAL, MAGIC, RARE or UNIQUE (default "RARE") |
| `--mod` | string[] | A modifier line; repeat --mod for several |
| `--implicit` | string[] | An implicit modifier line; repeat for several |
| `--name` | string | Item name |
| `--quality` | integer | Quality |
| `--equip` | string | Slot to equip it in |

### `pob items edit <item>`

Replace an item with new item text (keeps it equipped) *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--text` (required) | string | New item text (game copy text in any supported language) |

### `pob items edit-english <item>`

Replace an item with English PoB item text (advanced) *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--text` (required) | string | English item text |

### `pob items mod-add <item> <line>`

Add a modifier line to an item *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--kind` | `explicit` \| `implicit` \| `crafted` \| `enchant` \| `rune` \| `fractured` \| `desecrated` | explicit, implicit, crafted, enchant, rune, fractured or desecrated (default "explicit") |

### `pob items mod-remove <item> <line>`

Remove a modifier line from an item *(changes the build)*

### `pob items anoint <item> <notable>`

Anoint an item with a notable passive (Allocates …) *(changes the build)*

### `pob items corrupt <item>`

Mark an item corrupted, optionally adding corruption implicits *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--implicit` | string[] | Implicit line to add; repeat for several |

### `pob items runes [search]`

Search rune and soul core names

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--limit` | integer | Maximum results (default 30) |
| `--match` | string[] | Exact English names or node ids to match instead of text (filled in for searches in other languages) |

### `pob items set-rune <item> <socket> <rune>`

Socket a rune into an item (or "none" to empty the socket) *(changes the build)*

### `pob items trade <item>`

Trade site search link for items like this one

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--league` | string | League name (default "Standard") |
| `--site` | `global` \| `kakao` | global or kakao (Korea) (default "global") |
| `--min-percent` | integer | Minimum values as a percent of this item (default 90) |
| `--base` | boolean | Also require the same base type |
| `--status` | `available` \| `securable` \| `online` \| `any` | Listing status (default "available") |

### `pob items trade-query <item>`

Trade search query for items like this one (advanced)

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--min-percent` | integer | Minimum values as a percent of this item |
| `--base` | boolean | Also require the same base type |
| `--status` | string | Listing status |

### `pob items equip <item> <slot>`

Equip an item from the build in a slot *(changes the build)*

### `pob items unequip <slot>`

Empty a slot *(changes the build)*

### `pob items remove <item>`

Delete an item from the build *(changes the build)*

### `pob items toggle <slot>`

Turn a flask or charm on or off for calculations *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--active` (required) | boolean | On or off |

### `pob items uniques <text>`

Search PoB's unique item list

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--limit` | integer | Maximum results (default 20) |
| `--match` | string[] | Exact English names or node ids to match instead of text (filled in for searches in other languages) |

### `pob items bases <text>`

Search base item types

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--limit` | integer | Maximum results (default 20) |
| `--match` | string[] | Exact English names or node ids to match instead of text (filled in for searches in other languages) |

### `pob items slots`

Slot names available in this build

### `pob items weapon-set <set>`

### `pob items sets`

List item sets

### `pob items set-select <set>`

## Configuration

### `pob config list`

Configuration options (enemy, buffs, conditions) with current values

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--search` | string | Filter by key or label |
| `--changed` | boolean | Only options that differ from default |

```bash

```

### `pob config reset <key>`

Reset a configuration option to its default *(changes the build)*

### `pob config sets`

List configuration sets

### `pob config set-select <set>`

Switch to a configuration set *(changes the build)*

### `pob config set-new`

Create a configuration set *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--name` | string | Set name |
| `--copy` | boolean | Copy the current set |

## Calculations

### `pob calc stats`

Calculated stats of the main skill and the character

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--keys` | string[] | Only these stat keys |
| `--all` | boolean | Every numeric stat PoB computed |

### `pob calc skills`

Damage of every skill included in Full DPS

### `pob calc warnings`

Build warnings PoB shows (missing requirements, overcapped reservation, …)

### `pob calc whatif`

Stat changes from a hypothetical change, without keeping it

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--node` | string | Allocate this passive node |
| `--remove-node` | string | Remove this passive node |
| `--item` | string | Item text to try |
| `--slot` | string | Slot for --item |
| `--gem` | string | Support gem to add to the main skill group |
| `--config` | json | Configuration changes as {"key": value} |
| `--keys` | string[] | Stat keys to report |

```bash
pob calc whatif --node "Clean Shot"
pob calc whatif --config "{\"enemyIsBoss\":\"Pinnacle\"}"
```

### `pob calc whatif-english`

What-if with English item text (advanced)

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--node` | string | Allocate this passive node |
| `--remove-node` | string | Remove this passive node |
| `--item` | string | English item text |
| `--slot` | string | Slot for --item |
| `--gem` | string | Support gem to add to the main skill group |
| `--config` | json | Configuration changes as {"key": value} |
| `--keys` | string[] | Stat keys to report |

### `pob calc node-power`

Rank unallocated passive nodes near your tree by stat gain

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--stat` | string | Stat to rank by, e.g. FullDPS, TotalEHP or Minion.CombinedDPS (default: the main damage of the build) |
| `--limit` | integer | Maximum results (default 15) |
| `--max-distance` | integer | Only nodes this many points away or closer (default 6) |
| `--type` | `notable` \| `keystone` \| `any` | Only notable or keystone nodes (default "notable") |

### `pob calc compare <other>`

Compare the current build with another build code, link or saved build

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--keys` | string[] | Stat keys to compare |

### `pob calc compare-xml`

Compare the current build with another build given as XML (advanced)

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--xml` (required) | string | PoB build XML |
| `--keys` | string[] | Stat keys to compare |

### `pob calc calcs-options`

Calcs tab settings: which skill group it breaks down and the buff mode

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--group` | integer | Skill group for the Calcs tab |
| `--mode` | `UNBUFFED` \| `BUFFED` \| `COMBAT` \| `EFFECTIVE` | Buff mode |
| `--show-minion` | boolean | Show minion numbers |

## account

### `pob account status`

Whether PoB is signed in to your Path of Exile account *(needs the PoB window)*

### `pob account login`

Sign PoB in to Path of Exile (opens your browser to approve) *(needs the PoB window)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--timeout` | integer | Seconds to wait for the approval (default 180) |

### `pob account characters`

Characters on your account *(needs the PoB window)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--league` | string | Only this league |
| `--realm` | `PC` \| `Xbox` \| `PS4` | PC, Xbox or PS4 |

### `pob account import <character>`

Import a character (passive tree, jewels, items and skills) into the open build *(needs the PoB window)* *(changes the build)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--realm` | `PC` \| `Xbox` \| `PS4` | PC, Xbox or PS4 |
| `--tree` | boolean | Import the passive tree and jewels (default true) |
| `--items` | boolean | Import items and skills (default true) |
| `--clear-jewels` | boolean | Delete existing jewels (default true) |
| `--clear-skills` | boolean | Delete existing skills (default true) |
| `--clear-items` | boolean | Delete equipped items (default true) |
| `--ignore-weapon-swap` | boolean | Skip weapon swap items and skills |

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--index` | integer | Gem number to highlight |
| `--caption` | string | Short caption |

### `pob ui show-config <key>`

Open the Configuration tab and highlight an option *(needs the PoB window)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--caption` | string | Short caption |

### `pob ui show-stat <stat>`

Highlight a stat in the sidebar or the Calcs tab *(needs the PoB window)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--caption` | string | Short caption |

### `pob ui show-control <control>`

Highlight a named control of the current tab (advanced) *(needs the PoB window)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--caption` | string | Short caption |

### `pob ui clear`

Remove highlights *(needs the PoB window)*

### `pob ui tree-search [text]`

Type into the passive tree search so PoB circles every match *(needs the PoB window)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--caption` | string | Short caption |

### `pob ui heatmap <stat>`

Show the passive tree heat map for a stat (or "off") *(needs the PoB window)*

### `pob ui trade`

Open PoB's trade window (it signs in to the trade site itself) *(needs the PoB window)*

### `pob ui buy-similar <item>`

Open PoB's Buy Similar window for an item *(needs the PoB window)*

### `pob ui theme <theme>`

Shared panel and PoB theme: pob (original), dark, light, ocean, forest or sand (remembered for next time)

### `pob ui language <language>`

Show the PoB window in another language (remembered for next time)

The default, system, follows the Windows display language. An explicit language overrides it. Game names come from the game client; the interface text of PoB is translated by PoB AI. Text without a translation stays in English.

### `pob ui language-apply`

Apply a window language dictionary now (advanced) *(needs the PoB window)*

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--locale` (required) | string | Language |
| `--dict` | string | Dictionary file |

### `pob ui title-bar <style>`

Use the PoB AI title bar on the PoB window, or the Windows one (applies the next time PoB opens)

### `pob ui theme-apply <theme>`

Apply a theme to the open PoB window now (advanced) *(needs the PoB window)*
